== Biography ==
'''Kate Glasgow''' was present at, and the informant for, the death of [[Glasgow-3896|Daniel Glasgow]] of Kilrea on 16 October 1871; the register describes her as present at the death, at Kilrea. Her relationship to Daniel is not stated, and she is attached to him only as an uncertain daughter.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3896]] is assessed at 58% (possible). Kate was the informant present at Daniel's 1871 death at Kilrea, matching the family locality and a compatible 1830 generation. The record states no relationship, so daughterhood is a plausible close-family hypothesis rather than a father statement.

Selected Glasgow-3896 fatherhood of Glasgow-4094; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Seek Kate's marriage/death parent names or Daniel's will beneficiaries.

Source basis already held: [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/deaths_returns/deaths_1871/020759/7282767.pdf General Register Office of Ireland, civil death register (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/deaths_returns/deaths_1871/020759/7282767.pdf), Daniel Glasgow, Kilrea, 16 October 1871.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
